test_title: PYST 06: SSC Stenographer - English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 11 Dec 2024 - Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate idiomatic expression that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Today's managers' meeting has given me __a lot to think__ about as I decide whether or not to stay with this company.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4** i.e. **food for thought**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The phrase **"roll with the punches"** means to adapt to difficult circumstances. (मुसीबतों का सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example: **In business, you have to learn to roll with the punches and keep moving forward.
